reason: Meeko 0.8.0 successfully installed and passed identity tests, but receptor preparation failed before docking because HEM residue A:430 was not present in the default residue templates and automatic CCD template construction failed.

observations.failure_message: Input residues {'A:430': 'HEM'} not in residue_templates; Failed building template from CCD for resname='HEM'

corrective_action.change: Load an explicit HEM residue template from the official RCSB Chemical Component Dictionary ideal SDF using Meeko --add_templates HEM:<file>.

interpretation: MOLDISC-006 v1.1 produced no docking result and no valid docking evidence.
